scenarios.title: A｜名字与来自哪里
scenarios.setting: 玩家在朋友的聚会上认识了一个新朋友。

turns.text: Hey, I don’t think we’ve met before. I’m Jamie.

turns.prompt: 向对方提供登记所需的姓名，会怎么说？

choices.text: Hi, I’m Alex. Nice to meet you.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I’m Alex. Nice to meet you.
feedback.explanation: 初次见面时表达友好，配合姓名或简短自我介绍就能开启交流。

choices.text: Hey, I’m Alex. Nice to meet you too.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hey, I’m Alex. Nice to meet you too.
feedback.explanation: 初次见面时表达友好，配合姓名或简短自我介绍就能开启交流。

choices.text: Hi! I’m Alex. How do you know everyone here?

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi! I’m Alex. How do you know everyone here?
feedback.explanation: 询问对方是否掌握所需信息，也给“不清楚”留出回答空间。

choices.text: I don’t think we’ve met either. I’m Alex.

feedback.naturalExpression: I don’t think we’ve met either. I’m Alex.
feedback.explanation: “I don’t think”把不同意见表达为自己的判断，而不是直接断定对方错误。

choices.text: Hello, my name calls Alex.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I’m Alex. Nice to meet you.
feedback.explanation: 介绍姓名用“My name is …”或“I’m …”；“my name calls”把姓名当成了发出呼叫的人。

turns.text: Nice to meet you! Where are you from?

turns.prompt: 你想介绍自己的来处或生活经历，会怎么说？

choices.text: I’m from China.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m from China.
feedback.explanation: “I’m from”用于介绍来自哪里；地点信息能自然开启关于家乡的话题。

choices.text: I’m from Shanghai, China. How about you?

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m from Shanghai, China. How about you?
feedback.explanation: “I’m from”用于介绍来自哪里；地点信息能自然开启关于家乡的话题。

choices.text: I grew up in Shanghai, but I’m living here now.

feedback.naturalExpression: I grew up in Shanghai, but I’m living here now.
feedback.explanation: “grew up”谈成长经历，可用来说明家乡或成长环境。

choices.text: I’m originally from China, but I’ve been living here for a while.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m originally from China, but I’ve been living here for a while.
feedback.explanation: “I’ve been”把过去的经历或持续情况与现在联系起来，适合交代背景。

choices.text: I’m come from Shanghai.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m from China.
feedback.explanation: 说来自哪里可用“I’m from Shanghai”或“I come from Shanghai”，不能把两种结构拼在一起。

turns.text: I’m from Toronto, but I’ve lived here for about three years.

turns.prompt: 你想顺着对方的来处，聊聊来到这里的原因或体验，会怎么说？

choices.text: Oh, nice. What brought you here?

feedback.naturalExpression: Oh, nice. What brought you here?
feedback.explanation: 用简短问句核对刚听到的信息，省略的部分由前面的对话补足，适合当面确认细节。

choices.text: Do you like living here?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do you like living here?
feedback.explanation: 围绕一个具体动作或情况提问，让对方针对这一步确认或解释。

choices.text: Three years? You must know the city pretty well by now.

feedback.naturalExpression: Three years? You must know the city pretty well by now.
feedback.explanation: “must know”是根据住了三年作出的推测，借此邀请对方继续聊当地生活。

scenarios.title: B｜工作 / 学习
scenarios.setting: 在“认识新朋友”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“工作 / 学习”。

turns.prompt: 关于「认识新朋友」，对方在核实情况，你会怎样回答并补充必要的信息？

choices.text: I work in game development.

feedback.naturalExpression: I work in game development.
feedback.explanation: “work in game development”说明从事游戏开发这个领域，不必先列出具体职位。

choices.text: I’m a designer at a game company.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m a designer at a game company.
feedback.explanation: 直接交代自己当前的状态或安排，能让对方据此继续交流。

choices.text: I work as an artist. What about you?

feedback.naturalExpression: I work as an artist. What about you?
feedback.explanation: 把安排作为共同商量的建议提出，方便对方接受、调整或补充。

choices.text: I’m actually a student at the moment.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m actually a student at the moment.
feedback.explanation: “at the moment”表示目前、此刻，强调这是当前状态，不一定长期如此。

choices.text: My job is working in a game company.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: I work in game development.
feedback.explanation: “My job is working in a game company”把工作内容与雇主类型混在一起；直接说“I work at a game company”更清楚。

turns.text: That’s cool. What kind of work do you do there?

turns.prompt: 关于「认识新朋友」，对方在核实情况，你会怎样回答并补充必要的信息？

choices.text: I mainly work on environments and visual design.

feedback.naturalExpression: I mainly work on environments and visual design.
feedback.explanation: “mainly”限定主要工作范围，再点明场景和视觉设计，介绍更具体。

choices.text: I design environments for games.

feedback.naturalExpression: I design environments for games.
feedback.explanation: “design environments for games”直接说明工作内容，外行也容易理解。

choices.text: Mostly visual development and concept work.

feedback.naturalExpression: Mostly visual development and concept work.
feedback.explanation: “mostly”限定为主要情况，说明还有其他可能，而不是一概而论。

choices.text: It’s a little hard to explain, but I basically help design how the game world looks.

feedback.naturalExpression: It’s a little hard to explain, but I basically help design how the game world looks.
feedback.explanation: “a little”表示少量或轻微程度，适合表达希望只作小幅调整。

turns.text: That sounds interesting. Do you enjoy it?

turns.prompt: 关于「认识新朋友」，对方在核实情况，你会怎样回答并补充必要的信息？

choices.text: Yeah, for the most part. It can get pretty busy sometimes, though.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yeah, for the most part. It can get pretty busy sometimes, though.
feedback.explanation: 先直接肯定或否定，再补充细节；对方能先听清结论，再理解具体情况。

choices.text: I do. I especially like the creative side of it.

feedback.naturalExpression: I do. I especially like the creative side of it.
feedback.explanation: 先肯定喜欢这份工作，再指出创意部分，回答有了具体理由。

choices.text: It’s challenging, but I enjoy it. How about you? What do you do?

feedback.naturalExpression: It’s challenging, but I enjoy it. How about you? What do you do?
feedback.explanation: 把安排作为共同商量的建议提出，方便对方接受、调整或补充。

scenarios.title: C｜自然继续聊天
scenarios.setting: 两个人已经聊完基本信息，需要自然地把话题继续下去。

turns.text: So, how long have you been living here?

turns.prompt: 对方在确认时间或时长，你会怎样补充信息？

choices.text: About six months. I’m still getting to know the city.

feedback.naturalExpression: About six months. I’m still getting to know the city.
feedback.explanation: 用时间短语标明时点或持续时长，让对方能据此安排，而不只知道一个模糊的“晚点”。

choices.text: Not very long, actually. I moved here earlier this year.

feedback.naturalExpression: Not very long, actually. I moved here earlier this year.
feedback.explanation: 提供自己经历或做过的具体情况，让对方能在已知信息上继续确认。

choices.text: Just a few months. Do you have any places you’d recommend?

feedback.naturalExpression: Just a few months. Do you have any places you’d recommend?
feedback.explanation: 先确认有没有所需的物品、服务或安排，为后面的选择提供依据。

choices.text: Almost a year now. Time’s gone by really fast.

feedback.naturalExpression: Almost a year now. Time’s gone by really fast.
feedback.explanation: “Almost a year”说明接近一年，“Time’s gone by”顺势表达时间过得快。

turns.text: What do you think of it so far?

turns.prompt: 关于「认识新朋友」，对方在核实情况，你会怎样回答并补充必要的信息？

choices.text: I like it. There’s still a lot I haven’t explored yet.

feedback.naturalExpression: I like it. There’s still a lot I haven’t explored yet.
feedback.explanation: “I like”直接分享喜好，后面说出具体类别，能给对方继续聊的话题。

choices.text: Pretty good! I’m still getting used to a few things.

feedback.naturalExpression: Pretty good! I’m still getting used to a few things.
feedback.explanation: “getting used to”表示正在适应，后接名词或动词 -ing 形式。

choices.text: I really like the food here. I’ve been trying lots of different places.

feedback.naturalExpression: I really like the food here. I’ve been trying lots of different places.
feedback.explanation: “I’ve been”把过去的经历或持续情况与现在联系起来，适合交代背景。

choices.text: It’s definitely different from what I’m used to, but in a good way.

feedback.naturalExpression: It’s definitely different from what I’m used to, but in a good way.
feedback.explanation: “what I’m used to”指自己熟悉的方式，“in a good way”补充这种不同是积极的。

turns.text: We should grab coffee sometime. I can show you a few places.

turns.prompt: 你想回应一起喝咖啡的邀请，会怎么说？

choices.text: Yeah, I’d be up for that.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yeah, I’d be up for that.
feedback.explanation: 先直接肯定或否定，再补充细节；对方能先听清结论，再理解具体情况。

choices.text: That sounds great! I’d love to.

feedback.naturalExpression: That sounds great! I’d love to.
feedback.explanation: “I’d love to”热情表示愿意或很想做某事，后接动词原形。

choices.text: Sure. Let me know when you’re free.

feedback.naturalExpression: Sure. Let me know when you’re free.
feedback.explanation: “Let me …”提出由自己来做下一步，能明确谁来采取行动。

choices.text: Absolutely. We should exchange numbers.

feedback.naturalExpression: Absolutely. We should exchange numbers.
feedback.explanation: 先直接肯定或否定，再补充细节；对方能先听清结论，再理解具体情况。
